decision.observation: Region-2 orb room from farther west: Hornet stands on the cobblestone path between black mushrooms; the spiral-shell orb with its ribbed snail-shell knob on a curled arm is at the right. Left side has the huge black overhang dripping.
decision.hypothesis: The snail-shell knob with antennae resembles the living shell creature that transformed when struck repeatedly from close range. Earlier jump-attacks may have missed. Strike it repeatedly at close range from directly beneath its arm.
decision.memory: Living shells in this region transform when struck (with a delay). The knob may be another living shell.
